risks.title: Dependence on leased property rents
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Item 2 Properties, with strong language regarding dependence on non-cancelable leases of 10 to 25 years. The company operates a large number of sites under lease, creating significant exposure to fixed and variable costs. Compared to the prior year, this risk remains stable but central. The Industrial category carries high weight here.

risks.title: Restrictions on dividends and share buybacks
risks.score_rationale: Present in Item 5, the risk is highlighted by contractual restrictions in CUSA debt agreements. The language clearly indicates legal and financial limitations on dividends. Compared to N-1, the situation is stable but critical. The Capital category is highly weighted.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and incident management
risks.score_rationale: Addressed in Item 1C, the risk is treated seriously: the CTO oversees the program, monthly committees and semi-annual presentations to the Audit Committee are held. The incident response plan is formal. The intensity of the language shows increased vigilance. Newly reinforced compared to N-1.

risks.title: Competition for investor capital
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the performance graph (Item 5), CNK compares itself to AMC and IMAX to attract capital. The language is measured but reveals direct competitive pressure. This risk is stable. The Competition category has moderate weight.

risks.title: Ongoing litigation
risks.score_rationale: Referenced in Item 3, litigation is incorporated by reference to Note 19. The absence of details in the main text mitigates perceived intensity, but the formal mention indicates ongoing exposure. Stable compared to N-1.

risks.title: Inflationary pressures on costs
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 7, inflation affects concession and wage costs. The language indicates ongoing concern. Although managed through supplier diversification, pressure remains. Slight increase compared to N-1.

ai_positioning.summary: The company CNK does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report.
